rows: Ugh...
Rapunzel.
Am I going to die?
What?
How could a Nikke get a cold? It doesn't make sense.
Do you think there's something wrong with me?
There were so many things I still wanted to do. So many things I wanted to eat.
Snow White.
You're not sick.
Huh?
When we were out in the snowfield yesterday, you fell into a puddle, yes?
And you've been able to move around just fine since.
Uh... yeah...
Now, having said that, I have no doubt that you do indeed feel like you have a cold.
Your negative thoughts have manifested into physical symptoms.
It's a purely psychosomatic reaction.
But I really do feel sick.
The mind is a very powerful thing.
The way you think can hold great sway over whether you feel better or worse.
So you must always keep your mind strong.
Oh... I think I understand. I'll beat this illness, I'm sure of it.
Good. I'll pray for you to get better as well.
Um... Rapunzel.
I've been wondering about something for a while:
Why do you pray?
To alter my thoughts.
What do you mean?
Everything in this world depends largely on your mindset,
so I pray to change my own thoughts and those of others.
Whether it's the actual person doing the praying, or others watching them do so,
the act of prayer is a powerful force that can help change your mindset, which therein enacts positive change in all sorts of things.
After seeing you pray, I feel I'll get better much sooner now.
Hehe, good. Stay strong.
